title: SEGA Confirms Leak of 2.2 Million Newsletter Recipients' Email Addresses
content:
SEGA reported on Monday that the email addresses of 2,196,044 customers have been leaked after an unnamed third party accessed the systems of Arara, the company whose distribution system SEGA and SEGA Fave uses for their email newsletters. SEGA said that Arara is currently investigating the cause of the unauthorized access and is taking measures to prevent further damage.

SEGA has confirmation that email addresses and information associated with the newsletters' delivery have been leaked, but it emphasized there are no indications that customers' names, birthdates, genders, postal addresses, phone numbers, credit card information, and login passwords have also been leaked, as of the time of the announcement. SEGA also noted that a different distribution system handles the email addresses registered on customers' SEGA Accounts, and therefore the leak does not affect those addresses.

SEGA stated that the leaked email addresses leaked were from 11 affected newsletters sent in July, September, and October. Of the 2,196,044 leaked email addresses, 92,273 also had information associated with newsletter delivery leaked. Six of the 11 affected newsletters are tied to the " SEGA Lucky Kuji Online" prize game service, which is already undergoing maintenance, as part of security checks following a separate incident of unauthorized server access to SEGA Fave's arcade game network services.

SEGA Fave announced on November 2 that a third party accessed its servers without authorization, unrelated to the above leak of newsletter recipients' email addresses. The affected SEGA Fave servers are those for the arcade game network service ALL.Net and Aime (cards used by certain arcade games to store player information). The company suspended various related services for security checks on November 1, and services for some games remain unavailable. In addition to Sega itself, other companies such as Bandai Namco also use the affected services for certain arcade games.

title: Dragon Quest Teases New RPG for iOS, Android
content:
The Dragon Quest franchise announced Dragon Quest RPG: Makai-Ju to Michibikareshi Shima ( Dragon Quest RPG: The Demon World Tree and the Shepherded Island), a new game for iOS and Android devices, on Monday. Square Enix will debut the new game's announcement trailer on Tuesday at 8:00 p.m. JST (6:00 a.m. EST).

The Dragon Quest Monsters: Super Light mobile game launched in January 2014. The game ended its service in January 2024, making it the longest running Dragon Quest smartphone game, for almost 10 years.

The Dragon Quest Dokodemo Monster Parade smartphone game, which launched in 2015, ended its service in July 2020. The Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai smartphone game launched in September 2021, and ended its service in April 2023.

Dragon Quest Tact , the franchise 's tactical, role-playing smartphone game launched for iOS and Android devices in Japan in July 2020, and saw a Western release in January 2021. The game ended service in the West in February 2024.

The global version of Dragon Quest of the Stars ( Hoshi no Dragon Quest ) smartphone role-playing game launched in February 2020. The game ended service in June 2021. The game had the largest world in the series' history, and its focus was on exploring the world and fighting monsters.

title: Late Tetsuya Chiba's Autobiographical Manga to End in 8th Volume
content:
Chiba launched the Hinemosu Notari Nikki autobiographical short essay manga in Big Comic in December 2015. Shogakukan published the manga's first compiled book volume in 2018, and the seventh volume in November 2025. Chiba put the manga on hiatus on September 25, citing poor health. Chiba died on October 22 due to a myelodysplastic syndrome, a type of cancer that affects the blood cells in the bone marrow.

Chiba debuted as a professional manga creator when he was still in high school at 17 years old in 1956. He is perhaps best known for his Ashita no Joe ( Tomorrow's Joe ) boxing manga, which ran from 1968 to 1973, and has remained a mainstay in Japanese popular culture for decades. The manga inspired two television anime in 1970 and 1980, as well as two anime films in 1980 and 1981. The manga's story was re-imagined in a new sci-fi setting with new characters in 2018's Megalobox anime, which credits the original manga as its origin. The sequel series for Megalobox , Megalobox 2: Nomad , premiered in April 2021.

Ashita no Joe received its first official English release under the title Ashita no Joe: Fighting for Tomorrow in December 2024.

Chiba was nominated to the Japan Art Academy in 2022 as one of its first two manga creators (along with Yoshiharu Tsuge ). He was also the chair of the Japan Cartoonists Association.

Chiba was honored with the prestigious Order of Culture award in 2024, and was the first manga creator to have received the honor. The order is awarded to those "who have made outstanding contributions in developing" Japanese culture.

title: Heisei Haizan-hei ☆ Sumire-chan Manga Resumes on November 16
content:
Kodansha 's Weekly Young Magazine announced on Monday that Satomi U 's Heisei Haizan-hei ☆ Sumire-chan manga will resume serialization in this year's 51st issue of the magazine that will ship on November 16. The manga went on hiatus in mid-July when Satomi U took a maternity leave, although the magazine said at the time that her hiatus would last until mid-October.

In a handwritten message, Satomi U reported that she gave birth and that both she and her baby are doing well. In the lower right corner of her message, she drew a picture of her growing family, including what appears to be a "YounMaga" bear plush that the Young Magazine staff gifted her baby.

Satomi U launched the series in Kodansha 's Weekly Young Magazine in January 2024. Kodansha willl ship the manga's 12th compiled book volume on December 4. The manga was nominated in the Best General Manga category of Kodansha 's 50th annual Manga Awards in May.

Satomi U ended the Beauty and the Feast ( Yakumo-san wa Eduke ga Shitai ) manga in 2021. The artist launched the series in Square Enix 's Young Gangan magazine in March 2016. Square Enix shipped the 11th and final volume in March 2021. Square Enix Manga & Books shipped the final volume in English in November 2023.

title: Live-Action In the Clear Moonlit Dusk Film Rises to #2, 7th Be Forever Yamato: Rebel 3199 Film Opens at #10
content:
The live-action film adaptation of Yuu Nagira 's Nanji, Hoshi no Gotoku (You Are Akin to the Stars) novel rose from #3 to #2 in its fourth weekend. The film sold 107,000 tickets and earned 150,719,900 yen (about US$954,000) from Friday to Sunday. The film has sold a total of 1.15 million tickets and earned a cumulative total of 1,682,672,700 yen (about US$10.65 million).

The film opened in Japan on October 9, and ranked at #4 in its opening weekend. The film sold 234,000 tickets and earned 350,531,400 yen (about US$2.23 million) in its first three days.

The film stars Ryūsei Yokohama ( Detective Conan: Highway no Datenshi 's Kazuaki Ōmae) as Kai Aono and Suzu Hirose (live-action Chihayafuru films' Chihaya, The Boy and The Beast 's Kaede) as Akimi Inoue. Michihito Fujii (live-action Last Samurai Standing ) directed the film off a screenplay by Naoko Adachi (live-action Daytime Shooting Star , Un chocolatier de l'amour perdu ).

The novel's story begins on an island in the Seto Inland Sea. Akimi, who lives on the island, meets Kai, who just moved to the island. Both bond over their misgivings about their own families and life. Akimi's home life is strained by her father constantly cheating, while Kai's mother constantly makes both of them move to be with a new relationship. The two get into a complicated, supporting, and co-dependent relationship over the course of 15 years.

The live-action film reboot of CAPCOM 's Resident Evil survival horror game franchise rose from #5 to #3 in its fourth weekend. The film sold 81,000 tickets and earned 126,605,100 yen (about US$801,300) from Friday to Sunday. The film has sold a total of 1.18 million tickets and earned a cumulative total of 2,000,748,000 yen (about US$12.66 million).

The film opened in Japan on October 9 and ranked at #2 in its opening weekend. The film sold 356,000 tickets and earned 626,567,150 yen (about US$3.97 million) in its first three days.

The film opened in the United States on September 18. The film ranked at #1 and earned an estimated US$60 million in its opening weekend in the U.S.

The film stars Austin Abrams ( Weapons , Euphoria , Wolfs ) as Bryan. The cast also includes Zach Cherry , Kali Reis , and Paul Walter Hauser ( Richard Jewell , Black Bird , The Fantastic Four: First Steps ).

Zach Cregger ( Barbarian , Weapons ) directed the new film.

Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu ( Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of Mermaid Island), the first anime film adaptation of Nagano 's Chiikawa manga, dropped from #2 to #5 in its 15th weekend in Japan's box office. The film earned 92,808,300yen (about US$587,400) from Friday to Sunday.

The film has sold a total of 12.77 million tickets, and earned a cumulative total of 18,662,616,000 yen (about US$118 million). The film is currently the biggest film in Japan this year, and now ranks 12th in Japan's all-time box office ranking.

Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu opened on July 24 and ranked at #1 for its opening weekend. The film earned 990 million yen (about US$6.05 million) on its opening day. The film sold 1,508,500 tickets and earned 2,240,333,500 yen (about US$13.70 million) in its first three days.

The film's 4DX screenings began on September 5. One-day-only cheering screenings for the film took place on September 11. Penlight screenings took place on September 23.

The film is based on the manga's arc posted on X (formerly Twitter ) from March to November 2023, nicknamed the "Siren Arc" or "Island Arc."

Nagano is credited for the original story and also wrote the film's script. Under Nagano 's supervision, Kei Oikawa ( Uma Musume Pretty Derby 3 seasons, Hinamatsuri , My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU TOO! , My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU Climax ) directed the film at Cygames Pictures . QTORY inc. managed the production, and TOHO is distributing the film.

The 4K restoration of Studio Ghibli 's Whisper of the Heart rose from #10 to #6 in its second weekend back in theaters. The film earned 112,466,900 yen (about US$713,200) in its first three days.

The live-action film of Mika Yamamori 's In the Clear Moonlit Dusk ( Uruwashi no Yoi no Tsuki ) manga dropped from #4 to #7 in its second weekend. The film earned 61,363,800 yen (about US$388,400) from Friday to Sunday, and has earned a cumulative total of 334,113,100 yen (about US$2.11 million).

The film opened in Japan on October 23. The film sold 141,000 tickets and earned 200,272,200 yen (about US$1.27 million) in its first three days.

Shunsuke Michieda (live-action My Love Mix-Up! TV series, live-action The Kindaichi Case Files series) stars as Kohaku Ichimura, and Seira Anzai (live-action Insomniacs After School film, live-action Trillion Game TV series) stars as Yoi Takiguchi.

Other cast members include Rintarō Mizusawa as Takuto Ohji, Yuna Hoshino as Nobara Tone, Sayu Suzukawa as Kotobuki Hibiya, Takato Ōkura as Sentarō Akane, Tatsumi Asa as Shun Kuwabatake, Yūki Yoda as Yoshiko, and Naohito Fujiki as Seiichi Takiguchi, Yoi's father.

Kentarō Takemura (live-action Trillion Game TV series) directed the film, and Yuichi Tokunaga (live-action Densha Otoko TV series) wrote the script. Shū Kanematsu ( My Next Life as a Villainess: All Routes Lead to Doom! , Aquarion: Myth of Emotions ) composed the music. TBS TV oversaw production at TBS Sparkle , and TOHO is distributing.

Made in Abyss: Mezameru Shinpi ( Made in Abyss : Awakening Mystery), the first film in the new Made in Abyss anime film series , dropped from #6 to #8 in its second weekend.

The film opened on October 2023. It earned 145,525,480 yen (about US$922,900) in its first three days.

Masayuki Kojima ( Black Bullet , Tibetan Dog ) returned to direct the anime at the studio Kinema Citrus ( My Happy Marriage , The Rising of The Shield Hero ). Hideyuki Kurata ( Samurai Flamenco , The World God Only Knows ) was again in charge of scripts, and Kazuchika Kise ( Ghost in the Shell: Arise Alternative Architecture , xxxHOLiC ) and Yuka Kuroda ( Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun ) returned as character designers.

Kadokawa announced in January 2023 a sequel to the Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun ( Made in Abyss: Retsujitsu no Ōgonkyō ) anime.

Nijiiro no Rinne (Rainbow-Colored Reincarnation), the seventh film in Yamato yo Towa ni: Rebel 3199 ( Star Blazers: Be Forever Yamato - Rebel 3199 ), the latest project in the Space Battleship Yamato remakes, opened at #10. The film earned 72,323,820 yen (about US$457,700) in its first three days.

The film opened in theaters in Japan on October 30. The overall anime is premiering as seven films. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime under the title Star Blazers : Space Battleship Yamato 3199 .

The films' character designer Nobuteru Yūki drew the main visual (pictured right).

The sixth film, Aoi Meikyū (Blue Labyrinth), opened on June 26. In the story, the Yamato passes through a space time node that brings the main characters to the year 2026 in the present-day Reiwa era in Tokyo.

The fifth film opened in Japan on February 20.

title: My Hero Ultra Rumble Game Gets Mobile Version
content:
Bandai Namco Entertainment confirmed this month that its My Hero Ultra Rumble ( My Hero Academia Ultra Rumble in Japan) battle royale-style action game will have a mobile version. Bandai Namco Entertainment unveiled English and Japanese teaser videos for the game on Monday.

English teaser:

Japanese teaser:

The game launched in September 2023 for PlayStation 4, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, and PC via Steam .

The game centers on eight teams of three players each battling it out in each match. Characters in the game use their Quirks to do battle.

The latest game in the franchise , My Hero Academia : All's Justice , launched worldwide on February 6 (February 5 in Japan) for PlayStation 4, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam .

The My Hero Ultra Impact game ended service on May 18. The game launched for iOS and Android device in February 2022.

title: Hirayasumi TV Anime to Stream on Netflix
content:
Viz Media announced on Monday that the television anime of Keigo Shinzō 's Hirayasumi manga (a co-production with Shogakukan-Shueisha Productions Co., Ltd and Production +h. ) will stream internationally on Netflix in January. The anime's staff also announced on Monday that Gen Hoshino is performing the anime's opening theme song.

Viz Media describes the human drama story:

With a carefree outlook on life, Hiroto knows better than anyone that slowing down is sometimes the best way to move forward. At 29 years old, carefree Hiroto Ikuta doesn't have a girlfriend, a full-time job, or a plan for the future—and he couldn't be happier. Hiroto's breezy attitude isn't easy for everyone to understand, though. In a world filled with anxiety, confusion, and grief, Hiroto and the people who surround him are all just doing their best to figure out this thing called life. After developing an unlikely friendship with the grouchy old woman who lives in his neighborhood, Hiroto suddenly finds himself inheriting not just her house but some rather difficult emotions as well. His 18-year-old cousin, Natsumi, moves in with him, but as a struggling art student, she has her own troubles to deal with and may just put Hiroto's easygoing lifestyle to the test.

The anime stars:

• Yūma Uchida as Hiroto Ikuta

• Mayu Takahashi as Natsumi Kobayashi

• Rikako Aikawa as Hanae Wada

• Daisuke Namikawa as Hideki Noguchi

• Yōko Hikasa as Yomogi Tachibana

• Yume Miyamoto as Akari Yokoyama

• Yūichirō Umehara as Ryō Ishikawa

• Japanese television announcer Yūko Naitō as Narrator

Kei Suezawa ( Fate/Grand Order The Movie Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot - Wandering: Agateram, FLCL Progressive ) is directing the anime at Production +h. Naoyuki Asano (2022 Urusei Yatsura , Keep Your Hands Off Eizouken! , Mr. Osomatsu ) is designing the characters. At 29 years old, carefree Hiroto Ikuta doesn't have a girlfriend, a full-time job, or a plan for the future—and he couldn't be happier. Hiroto's breezy attitude isn't easy for everyone to understand, though. In a world filled with anxiety, confusion, and grief, Hiroto and the people who surround him are all just doing their best to figure out this thing called life. After developing an unlikely friendship with the grouchy old woman who lives in his neighborhood, Hiroto suddenly finds himself inheriting not just her house but some rather difficult emotions as well. His 18-year-old cousin, Natsumi, moves in with him, but as a struggling art student, she has her own troubles to deal with and may just put Hiroto's easygoing lifestyle to the test.

title: Live-Action Golden Kamuy: Karafuto Pursuit Arc Series Unveils More Cast
content:
The official website for Golden Kamuy : Karafuto Tsuiseki-hen (Gol den Kamuy: Karafuto Pursuit Arc), the new live-action series based on Satoru Noda 's Golden Kamuy manga, unveiled two more cast members as well as a new key visual for the series on Monday.

The newly announced cast members are:

Ayana Shiramoto as Sofia Golden Hand

Hiroto Ōshita as Kirawus

Kenji Katagiri is returning to direct the new series alongside new director Masaaki Yoshimura . Tetsuo Kamata (live-action BLUE LOCK film) is the new scriptwriter. Yutaka Yamada and Yoshiaki Dewa are returning to compose the music. Hiroshi Nakagawa and Debo Akibe are again serving as the Ainu language and cultural advisers. CREDEUS is again producing the series.

The live-action series will debut streaming on WOWOW on January 24.

The first live-action Golden Kamuy film opened in Japan in January 2024 and topped the Japanese box office in its first weekend. The film sold 356,000 tickets for 533,848,690 yen (about US$3.44 million in current conversion) in its first three days. Netflix began streaming the first film in May 2024.

Shigeaki Kubo directed the first film at production company CREDEUS . Tsutomu Kuroiwa wrote the script. Yutaka Yamada composed the music. Hiroshi Nakagawa and Debo Akibe were credited as Ainu culture advisers.

Kenji Katagiri , Ken Ochiai , and Yōsuke Satō joined the film's director Kubo on directing the follow-up Golden Kamuy -The Hunt of Prisoners in Hokkaido- live-action series . Similarly, Yoshiaki Dewa joined the film's composer Yamada for the series. Japanese rock group ACIDMAN performed the theme song "Kagayakerumono" (Those Who Shine). The live-action series debuted in October 2024, and Netflix added the series in February 2025.

Kento Yamazaki reprises his role as Saichi Sugimoto and Anna Yamada as Asirpa. Yū Inaba , Sōkō Wada , and Tetta Sugimoto joined the film's cast as Tokishige Usami, Toshiyuki Kadokura, and Anji Toni, respectively.

Kenji Katagiri directed the film at CREDEUS based on a script by returning writer Tsutomu Kuroiwa . Yutaka Yamada was also back to compose the music, and Hiroshi Nakagawa and Debo Akibe served as Ainu culture and language supervisors.

Rock band 10-FEET performed the theme song "Kowarete Kieru made" (Until It Breaks and Disappears).

Noda launched the manga in Shueisha 's Young Jump magazine in 2014, and ended it in April 2022. The manga has inspired four anime seasons. The show's final arc premiered on January 5, and will continue this winter with the climactic "Runaway Train" arc.

title: Fool Night Manga Crosses 1 Million Copies Worldwide
content:
Viz Media licensed the manga, and it describes the story:

Kamiya is at the end of his rope. His mother is ill, and his job barely pays for her medication, much less food. With few options left, he considers the life-changing process of transfloration. Ready to give his body up for a payday, Kamiya is about to explore the limits of society's waning humanity.

Yasuda launched the manga in Shogakukan 's Big Comic Superior magazine in November 2020. Shogakukan released the manga's 13th compiled book volume on June 30, and will release the 14th on November 30.

The manga ranked #12 in the male reader list of the 2023 edition of Takarajimasha 's Kono Manga ga Sugoi! (This Manga Is Amazing!) guidebook.

The television anime of the manga will premiere worldwide on Netflix on November 26. Atsuyuki Yukawa ( Suzume unit director) is directing the anime at Sunrise and SHAFT . Jin Tanaka ( Oshi no Ko ) is writing the script. Robert Satō is designing the characters. Tatsuya Katō ( Dr. Stone ) is composing the music.

title: Ingoku Danchi: Deviant's Apartment Complex Anime's English Dub Streams on November 11
content:
OceanVeil announced on Friday that it will begin streaming the English dub for Ingoku Danchi: Deviant's Apartment Complex , the short television anime of writer Sakusei Kenkyūjo and artist Yui Jōyama 's Ingoku Danchi (Indecent Apartment Complex) manga on November 11 at 11:00 p.m. EST.

The English dub cast inlcudes:

• Chloe Eves as Kiritani, Katagiri, Watanabe, Ichinose, Kanzaki, Sanamori

• Mana T. Johnson as Goda, Shikijo, Mizutani, Ikayama, Sakakura

• Shay-Ki Fullalove as Yoshida

• Christopher Escalante as Narrator

• Aria Pierce as Numajiri

• Jessica Warner as Shoda, Justice Man

• Abby Pasion as Hasegawa

• KyLeigh Zimmerer asTsujisaki

• Angela Tran as Shirakage

• Zoe Lee as Haibara

• Steve Warky Nunez as Yoshida's Dad

• Aife as Ando

• Khai Truong as Young Man

• Erin Tenelle as Boy, Housewife C

• Amanda Parker as Housewife A

• Rebecca Trepanier as Housewife B, NTR Wife

• Savy Des-Etages as Housewife D

• Jesse Inocalla as Mizutani's Husband, NTR Husband

• Christiaan Connors as Male Resident, Old Man, Man A

• Meredith Nudo as Horny Houswife

• Zack Maher as Horny Househusband

• KyLeigh Zimmerer, Erin Tenelle, Nina Nikolic, Zoe Lee, Rebecca Trepanier, Savy Des-Etages, Roo Ryder as Housewives

• Dré Ayala, Jesse Inocalla, Khai Truong, Steve Warky Nunez as Househusbands

OceanVeil describes the anime:

"Protect the peace of the complex from the threat of deviant housewives, Rookie Manager Yoshida!"

When Yoshida stepped in as his father's substitute manager for the apartment complex, he expected leaky faucets and noisy neighbors. Instead, he found a living nightmare of high-rise proportions!

The local housewives have traded their aprons for the "Libido Cloth"—lewd, madness-inducing garments that have turned the hallways into a frenzy of forbidden desires. From the chaotic rampages of residents like Watanabe and Ichinose to the looming, high-class threat of the "Class-A Housewife" Kanzaki, the darkness in the complex is deepening—and even the police shadows seem to be hiding something sinister.

Armed with his only counter-measure, the "Voltac Claw," Yoshida is the last line of defense. Can one rookie manager survive the onslaught, or will he be swallowed whole by the apartment's deepest secrets?

Toshikatsu Tokoro ( The Highschool Life of a Fudanshi , Plus-Sized Elf , Why the Hell are You Here, Teacher!? ) directed the anime at Elias . Eeyo Kurosaki ( Ichigo Aika: Strawberry Elegy , The Titan's Bride , Unexpectedly Naughty Fukami ) was in charge of series scripts, Shingo Nishimoto ( Plus-Sized Elf , The Fruit of Evolution 2: Before I Knew It, My Life Had It Made , chief animation director) designed the characters, and Ruzarin Kashiwagi composed the music.

Additional staff members include:

• Color Key Artist: Shūichi Satō

• Art Director: Shinobu Takahashi

• Compositing Director of Photography: Yoshikazu Miyagawa

• Sound Director: Akinori Shiba

The anime premiered in Japan on April 5 on BS11 at 25:10 JST (effectively April 6 at 1:10 a.m.), then on April 7 on Tokyo MX . AnimeFesta exclusively streams the anime's completely uncensored version in Japan, and also streams the on-air version with DMM TV . The anime's standard broadcast version and fully uncensored version debuted on WWWave Corporation 's new anime streaming platform OceanVeil on April 5.

The manga launched on Kadokawa 's Dra Dra Sharp# online manga magazine on the Nico Nico Seiga service in 2021. Kadokawa published the manga's ninth compiled book volume on February 9.
author: ANN
